# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-1, from
# tools/vivado-parity/lutram.sh. `routed` is its cell count after routing,
# `cell` each memory cell it left and its bel, `sitepin` the site pins each
# pin of a named cell's leaves reaches at its own site, from its own report
# (lutram_probe.tcl), with the sites taken off. `slice` lines are its
# bitstream decoded through this repository's database, one per slice
# holding a RAM: tests/fpga_xray_lutram_vivado.rs says how to read one.
design mem128x1
  routed BUFG=1 FDRE=18 IBUF=2 MUXF7=2 OBUF=1 RAM128X1D=1 RAMD64E=4
  cell mem_reg_0_127_0_0 RAM128X1D bel SLICEM.A6LUT
  cell mem_reg_0_127_0_0/DP.HIGH RAMD64E bel SLICEM.A6LUT
